design: 96 heldout transfer copy prompts, frozen new-wording discovery means. For each predicted/exact boundary state: all attention predicted, all exact,8 single exact repairs,8 leave-one-predicted conditions. Each mask bit chooses exact donor attention output at layer10+bit; other writes use receiver-native baseline plus new discovery mean. MLPs run naturally; no refit or layer selection.
limitations: Exact donor repairs localize error, not deployable prediction or causal shares. Layer ranking exploratory; no best-layer validation. All6 families retained; known task/form and native receiver baseline.
